description: Gun feedback for the Godot FPS: muzzle flash, tracer, impact sparks + bullet-hole decal, blood spray (+ wall splat). One procedural autoload GfGunfx (no textures) fired by the net kit through a shot_fx RPC after the server raycast, misses included. Presets counter-strike / arcade / subtle. 0 credits.

out_dir.description: Godot project root: writes scripts/gf_gunfx.gd, gripforge/gunfx.json and the CC0 sprites into gripforge/gunfx/ (+ LICENSES.txt)
